messages.en:
{07 15 00}WHAT?! {01 00 00 05 00}Why are you all up in
my business?{01 01 00}{01 08 00} NO, I HAVEN'T
CAUGHT THE BUG YET!
{07 16 00}But {01 00 00 05 00}just you wait and see,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}MIDA?! {01 00 00 05 00}Miks sa toppid nina
mu asjadesse?{01 01 00}{01 08 00} EI, MA POLE
SEDA PUTUKAT VEEL PÜÜDNUD!
{07 16 00}Aga {01 00 00 05 00}oota ja vaata,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}I still haven't found a bug
that's worthy, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
Yeah, I'm choosy.
{07 01 00}But so what?! {01 01 00}{07 06 00}I'll find one
that'll make your eyes bug
out and your brain melt!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ma pole ikka leidnud
väärilist putukat, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
Jah, ma olen valiv.
{07 01 00}Aga mis siis?! {01 01 00}{07 06 00}Leian ühe,
mis paneb su silmad
punni ja aju sulama!
